newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Economists pick June qtr core inflation of 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Economists pick June qtr core inflation of 0.3 pct.

text.p: A survey of three economists present at the release of June quarter Consumers Price Index data on Tuesday yielded an average forecast of 0.3 percent core inflation for the quarter.
They saw on average a 1.5 percent rise in core inflation in the June year.
The economists were unanimous in their forecasts.

The Reserve Bank of New Zealand will use the CPI data, released by Statistics New Zealand, to calculate underlying inflation. The bank is expected to release its calculation about an hour after the 10.45 a.m. (2245 GMT) release of the CPI.
Statistics New Zealand said the CPI, which includes government charges, changes in interest rate charges and one-offs, rose 0.1 percent in the June quarter and 1.1 percent in the year.
